info.title: CopyPaste template video projects
info.description: Additive versioned video project contract. Native composition, frozen sources, integer frame timeline, durable render queue, cancellation, scoped actual MP4/source/script/storyboard/VTT/probe delivery and bounded inline preview. No AI generation or whole-product qualification. Original OpenAPI remains unchanged.

VideoDefinition.description: Runtime additionally requires a supported rational frame rate, 3–60 seconds, even dimensions, <=2.1 billion pixel-frames, ordered contiguous scenes covering every frame, ordered non-overlapping captions, distinct keys and currently authorized fixed project source versions. Provided narration text is not synthesized speech.
